messages:
Priya Patel: paging 1: elevated 5xx and timeouts from model pool eu-west3 starting ~11:07 UTC. Customers seeing spikes in generation errors.
infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2416009123. Severity: P1. Notifying oncall.
oncall-bot: @Marcus Reed you are now on-call for INC-2416009123.
Marcus Reed: I'm oncall, joining. What's the failure mode?
Jorge Alvarez: logs show repeated OOM and occasional SIGSEGV in attention GPU kernel (libattn_cuda.so). Sample lines:
```
CUDA error: out of memory at attention_kernel.cu:233
signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7ffeadc...
#0  attn_forward_impl
#1  runtime_step
```
Nina Walsh: metrics: 4.3% 5xx across /v1/chat and /v1/generate, tail latency spikes 2-4x. Memory footprint of model-runner processes climbs steadily with long-lived sessions (KV cache + continuous batching).
Marcus Reed: immediate triage: 1) reduce concurrent batches, 2) disable continuous batching, 3) lower max_sequence / truncate long context at router layer, 4) failover to smaller quantized variant.
Priya Patel: execute config changes & traffic steering. We need minimal disruption. Which pool? eu-west3-runners-mlg.
Jorge Alvarez: running redwoodctl diff shows runtime.runtime_config.batch.max_requests_per_batch=8 currently. Proposal to set to 1 for now.
Marcus Reed: applying change: 
```
redwoodctl patch pool eu-west3-runners-mlg --set runtime.batch.max_requests_per_batch=1 --set runtime.batch.continuous=false
```
deploy-bot: patch queued -> deploying to 5% canary.
Priya Patel: also setting router-level max_context=2048 to truncate incoming payloads so we don't hit memory extremes.
Support Ops: flagged customers impacted: retail-data (high error rate), sentiment-hq. Notified both.
Jorge Alvarez: after canary apply, canary logs show OOMs stop. Canary stable for 2m.
infra-bot: Canary success. Promoting to 30% pool.
Marcus Reed: in parallel, start controlled drain of pods with repeated crashcounts >3 and replace with fresh nodes. 
```
kubectl get pods -l pool=eu-west3-runners-mlg | grep CrashLoopBackOff | awk '{print $1}' | xargs -I{} kubectl delete pod {}
```
Nina Walsh: capturing coredumps and GPU traces for the crashed pods; dumping NVTX traces for failing sessions.
Priya Patel: routing changes to reduce blast radius: move 40% traffic to eu-west1 fallback pool and 20% to mlg-7b-quant variant.
Marcus Reed: routed with redwoodctl: 
```
redwoodctl route set --from-pool eu-west3-runners-mlg --to-pool eu-west1-runners --percent 40
redwoodctl route set --from-pool eu-west3-runners-mlg --to-model mlg-7b-q4 --percent 20
```
Support Ops: observed global 5xx drop from 4.3% -> 1.0% in 3 minutes. Retail-data reports partial recovery but some requests slowed.
Jorge Alvarez: root cause hypothesis: memory leak in attention tuner when prefix KV cache and continuous batching are both enabled for long contexts; leak accumulates pointers and eventually OOM or corrupts heap causing SIGSEGV. Repro locally by sending repeated long-context requests with continuous batching enabled; leak shows on heap profiler.
Marcus Reed: long-term fix paths: patch attention kernel to free intermediate buffers reliably, add allocator guardrails, and add runtime circuit-breaker to force synchronous path when memory pressure detected. Also add an alert for steady memory increase trend per pod.
Priya Patel: immediate follow-ups: escalate to runtime team for a hotfix build, add CI regression (warm cache + continuous batching + long context), and update our runbooks.
deploy-bot: created release candidate rc-2416-attn-fix with extra dealloc and bounds checks.
Jorge Alvarez: testing rc-2416 on canary harness now; initial passes look promising under stress.
Marcus Reed: plan to roll rc to pool after validation. Target full restore in 2.5h.
Nina Walsh: I'll own crash analysis and heap/profile artifacts. Adding task to add alert rule: MemoryIncreaseBy > 25% over 10m -> Pager.
Support Ops: customers informed: retail-data and sentiment-hq got status update and estimated full recovery ETA 2.5h. They asked for incident timeline and impact numbers.
Priya Patel: customer impact summary for incident: approx 1.9% of total requests saw 5xx, retail-data experienced 37% failure rate during spike window (~12min), sentiment-hq ~9%. No PII leak or storage corruption found so far.
Marcus Reed: once fix is deployed, we'll re-enable continuous batching gradually behind health checks and memory monitors.
Jorge Alvarez: adding safety: runtime will expose metric runtime.memory.heap_growth_rate and a new config to auto-disable continuous batching on threshold.
infra-bot: INC-2416009123 updated: mitigations applied (batching reduced, continuous batching disabled, traffic rerouted). Monitoring.
Support Ops: compiling impacted request ids and customer contact logs for postmortem.
Priya Patel: great work. We'll keep monitoring for 1 hour then transition to postmortem. Thanks team.
oncall-bot: @team oncall rotation resumed.
